scope: Independent synchronized art demonstration; no combat damage or game simulation

clock.seek_policy: cancel all audio; resume schedules future events only

audio_delivery.map_format: cue-map.json with cues array entries {branch, variant, phase, path, duration, peak, rms}; path relative to map directory
audio_delivery.normalization: paired basic/enhanced comparable RMS or loudness, peak below -1dBFS, finite PCM and no clipping; document source and layering
audio_delivery.consumer_behavior: Only one comparison side audio plays at a time. User gesture unlock, mute/volume, source cancellation on pause/seek/reset/branch change/hidden/end, no infinite loops.
